summary: Qoder International gives every individual account, including the $0 Free plan, 100 Credits per day that you claim manually in the Qoder desktop app. Each claim is valid for 30 days, so unused Credits carry over until they expire; missed days cannot be claimed later. Teams and Enterprise subscribers are not eligible, and the end date is "to be announced". Qwen3.8-Flash is also free: its Credit rate is cut from 0.1x to 0.0x and it works even with a zero balance. That offer was extended past September 30, and Qoder says the end date will be announced in advance; responses may be slower at peak times. Separately, Qoder's October 19 post made DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 cost 0.0x Credits for free and paid users through October 24; its October 24 post extends that window: the model stays at 0x credits until November 1, 00:00 (UTC+8). Signup was not tested, so whether a card is required is unconfirmed, and data-use terms for free-model usage were not reviewed.
claim_steps: Download the Qoder desktop app and create or sign in to an individual Qoder International account.
During the daily window (opens 10:00 Singapore time, UTC+8), open the Usage panel, click the gift icon in the lower-left corner, and claim 100 Credits. Missed days cannot be claimed later.
Use the Credits with the same account in the Qoder IDE, JetBrains plugin, CLI, Cloud Agents, mobile or web app. Each claim expires 30 days after it is claimed.
For the free models, just select Qwen3.8-Flash or DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (0x credits until November 1, 00:00 UTC+8) in the Qoder model picker; no claim is needed.
